articles.headline: 10-man Bournemouth beat Celta Vigo to top Europa League
articles.description: Bournemouth moved a step closer to automatic qualification for the Europa League round of 16 after coming from behind with 10 men to win 2-1 at Celta Vigo.

articles.headline: Adam Wharton sees red as Crystal Palace rescue Europa League draw with Hoffenheim
articles.description: Daichi Kamada's last-gasp leveller salvaged a 1-1 Europa League draw for Crystal Palace against Hoffenheim after Adam Wharton was sent off in the second half at Selhurst Park.
